html/semantics/interactive-elements/the-.means: Chromium 141 does not raise a dialog above a later one when its open attribute is removed and showModal() is called on it. The PORT upgrades a server-written dialog by close() and then showModal(), not by removing the attribute, and layer.browser.test.ts looks at that upgrade: nothing for the PORT.

Chromium 141 moves focus into an inert dialog opened with show(), against the HTML Standard's focusing steps. The PORT shows modal dialogs and popovers, never an inert non-modal dialog: nothing for the PORT.

dom/nodes/moveBefore/focus-preserve.html.means: The known defect of Bet 9 (decision I12): moveBefore() does not keep a backward selection in Chromium 141. The PORT restores the selection and its direction itself after every move, whether or not the browser has moveBefore: nothing more for the PORT.

html/semantics/interactive-elements/the-.means: Chromium 141 gives initial focus in a dialog to a mouse-focusable element (tabindex=-1) and to a nested autofocus element, where the HTML Standard says the first keyboard-focusable one. The PORT leaves initial focus to the browser: a dialog whose first focusable thing has tabindex=-1 gets focus there in this browser; the PORT's own dialogs hold ordinary controls (the vectors).
